Informal for cela. High-frequency French pronoun meaning 'that'; clitic object forms precede the conjugated verb.
With time. High-frequency French pronoun meaning 'that'; clitic object forms precede the conjugated verb.
The most common verb. Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Core French verb meaning 'to be'.
Ce + est. Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Core French verb meaning 'to be'.
Irregular plural: les yeux. Masculine noun ('le œil', plural 'les yeux') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'eye'.

examples.text: Les yeux il y a deux ans.
Du Botox chaque année, et les yeux il y a deux ans.
examples.trans: Botox every year, and her eyes two years ago.
